citations.documentTitle: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer — Emergency Response Plan (AWIA / SDWA §1433)
citations.quote: - Pressure below 20 psi across a zone or an area of more than 500 connections; a break on a transmission main (16-inch or larger). - Treatment process failure: combined filter effluent turbidity above

citations.quote: - Public health language goes out on time even when the cause is not yet known. The clock in Section 5 runs from the moment the Director decides, not from when the cause is understood. - One voice: ev

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance a residential street with a utility crew around an open excavation, water running along the curb, a backhoe, neighbors watching, daylight. Phone snapshot taken at eye level, slightly tilted, flash glare on glass. A child's hand holds a translucent plastic tumbler filled with tap water, fingers gripping the rim. The water is visibly cloudy, with a faint pinkish tinge. A red sticker, crumpled at the edges, is taped over the tap spout on the kitchen faucet behind the glass. The background shows a dimly lit kitchen counter, unbranded cabinets, a small sink with a cracked tile near the drain. The child's face is partially visible in the reflection on the glass, pale and anxious. The screen is slightly out of focus, the image framed tightly on the glass and sticker. Overcast daylight through a window, muted tones. logos, or brand marks.
